Topwater baits also are working on the smallmouth. Largemouth bass also will hit a PBJ jig on the edge of bushes. Crappie are favoring beetle spins around the bushes on the upper end of the lake.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Harris Brake Lake fishing report
reports.text: Harris Brake Lake Resort (501-889-2745) said they had no overall report for this week on fishing or conditions, but they did report that some people have been catching some bream, crappie and bass.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Lake Catherine (Below Carpenter Dam) fishing report
reports.text: No crappie or walleye reports are available. Trolling crankbaits against the current that imitate threadin shad is an excellent method of locating schools of bass.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Lake Charles fishing report
reports.text: What she has heard is that crappie are biting well now, and catfish catches are good using goldfish and minnows.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Lake Hamilton fishing report
reports.text:
On sunny days the water temp approaches 70 degrees in most areas and fish are beginning to show signs of summertime patterns for bass.
No crappie report, and with the weather it’s likely not great anyway.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Lake Maumelle fishing report
reports.text:
Largemouth bass are good. As an indicator of the bass bite, Stephen Dillon and Barry Wolfe teamed to catch a 12.08-pound stringer to win Tuesday night’s bass tournament (the Tuesday tournaments are ongoing now). Phillip Cole and Jason Bargil hooked a 5.08-pound Big Bass.
Kentucky bass are good. There are some reports of them being found outside the grass line, while they can also be found in 12-16 feet off drops and rocky banks. White bass fishing is fair. Some reportedly can still be found mixed in with the crappie on the flats or near brush piles in 8-12 feet of water. Try using minnows, Rooster Tails, jerkaits and rattle-type baits. The crappie bite is fair. There have been reports of…

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Lake Nimrod fishing report
reports.text:
In the photo right, Benton’s Clyde Rowan caught this mess of crappie at Nimrod using Bobby Garland Jigs in the colors blue ice and money milk.
Crappie are good. Black bass tournaments are underway at Nimrod on Tuesdays, and last week a 19-pound stringer won the tournament. Overall, bass fishing is good.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Lake Norrell fishing report
reports.text: Lisa Spencer at Lisa’s Bait Shop (501-778-6944) said the crappie have been shallow, but some regulars out there say they have went deep again. Crappie have been doing well off of both regular crappie minnows and pink minnows. Bass are doing well off of goldfish and Zing Tails and plastics.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Lake Winona fishing report
reports.text: Lisa Spencer at Lisa’s Bait Shop (501-778-6944) said crappie have been good on minnows and jigs. Bass have been hitting crankbaits and spinnerbaits.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Little Maumelle River fishing report
reports.text: Black bass catching good on spinnerbaits, crankbaits and soft plastic worms. Crappie fishing had been poor after they had finished spawning.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Millwood Lake fishing report
reports.text: * Largemouth bass: The majority of largemouth on Millwood are now post-spawn and starting to recover from the past couple weeks, upriver and in many locations. Best water clarity is in the back of oxbows but bass are finicky as to what will get a response. Bass Assassin Shads, Trick Worms, wacky-rigged Senkos and Twitch Sticks have been getting fair responses from decent 14- to 15-inch bass for the last couple of weeks. A large number of the post-spawn bass have pulled out of the flats, although a few decent fish remain in 1-2 feet depth. reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Peckerwood Lake fishing report
reports.text: Crappie fishing is good; anglers are catching them trolling in the brush or focusing minnows and jigs around the brush piles. Black bass are good; no baits mentioned.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Saline River Access in Benton fishing report
reports.text: Lisa Spencer at Lisa’s Bait Shop (501-778-6944) says lots of bass are being reported caught off of live crawfish, black salties and Brush Hogs. ”One of my customers said his girlfriend had caught a big walleye off of a black salty,” Lisa said. “Thinking it was a bass, she ending up cutting her thumb up while trying to lip it.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Sunset Lake fishing report
reports.text: Bass have been doing well off of black salties and also Zoom Trick Worms fished wacky style. Crappie have been caught off of pink minnows and No. 6 crappie minnows.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: White Oak Lake fishing report
reports.text: Popular baits for the black bass are crawfish, bass shiners and artificial lures.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: White River fishing report
reports.text: Bank anglers have also found a lot of success in these waters jigging bronze-colored spoons with a light rainbow pattern – these active rainbows were even chomping on white crappie jigs.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Bear Creek Lake/Storm Creek Lake fishing report
reports.text:
Natalie Faughn, assistant superintendent at Mississippi River State Park (870-295-4040), says that Bear Creek Lake has had reportedly high bass activity.
Meanwhile, Storm Creek Lake has also seen a rise in bass activity, though not as substantially reported as on Bear Creek.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Lake Maumelle fishing report
reports.text: Largemouth bass are good. Kentucky bass are good. Some reportedly can still be found mixed in with the crappie on the flats or near brush piles in 8-12 feet of water. The crappie bite is fair.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Lake Sequoyah fishing report
reports.text: Crappie are shallow and the bite is good. Black bass became more active with the drop in water this week, as catches were good.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Lake Ouachita fishing report
reports.text:
Hudson Grant, all of 4 years old, caught this nice bass on Lake Ouachita.
(updated 5-6-2020) Todd Gadberry at Mountain Harbor Resort and Spa (870-867-2191/800-832-2276 out of state) reports that black bass are still very good. Crappie are good.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Arkansas River fishing report
reports.text:
They hear good reports in backwater angling efforts for black bass; good catches have been reported, with the anglers using black/blue jigs, black/red tubes, buzzbaits and frogs.
Crappie can be found active in the backwaters. Black bass are also biting in the backwaters.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Beaver Lake fishing report
reports.text:
Shad are on a big spawn and that is creating some good topwater action for bass. Spotted bass and the smallmouth bite are good on the lower end of lake. Crappie are in all phases as we have caught them deep in 35 feet of water and up shallow, 3 feet or less in buckbrush.
Crappie catching has been fair. Some are shallow while others are more in the deeper areas – “it’s kind of weird with the crappie right now,” they note. Black bass are good.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Beaver Tailwater fishing report
reports.text: The Kentucky bass bite has been fair, still suspended around ledges, chunk rock, structure and points.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Greers Ferry Lake fishing report
reports.text:
Crappie are still spawning upriver and a lot downlake in selected areas; use jigs and minnows around bushes. Black bass are eating, spawning and guarding fry all over the lake and rivers.
(updated 5-6-2020) Fish ’N Stuff (501-834-5733) in Sherwood says smallmouth bass are biting well on the lower end of the lake on Carolina rigs and peanut butter and jelly finesse jigs. Largemouth bass are good on the upper end; fish with topwater lures, buzzbaits and frogs or by flipping a jig around the bushes.

reports.text: Crappie are good on minnows, jigs and worms, but they have been small. No reports on black bass or bream.

reports.title: Lake Nimrod fishing report
reports.text: Crappie are fair and it appears they are spawning. No reports on black bass.

reports.text: Crappie reports have been poor. Black bass reports have been good.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Brewer Lake fishing report
reports.text: Crappie also are good. Minnows and jigs, naturally, with Monkey Milk and Purple Monkey jigs along with tri-color crappie tubes being the best choices. Black bass are good.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Felsenthal fishing report
reports.text: Both bream and crappie fishing have been slow. A few black bass and some catfish are being caught.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Lake Atkins fishing report
reports.text: Black bass are good. Bass minnows and swimbaits are among the most successful baits the past week. No reports on bream, crappie or catfish.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Lake Columbia fishing report
reports.text: Sportsman’s One Stop in El Dorado (870-863-7248) says they hear that a few bass are being caught, but they’ve heard no other reports from Magnolia.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: DeGray Lake fishing report
reports.text: Some crappie are still in the middle of their spawn.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Lake Sequoyah fishing report
reports.text: Crappie fishing was OK; anglers reported a fair bite around the shoreline using minnows and jigs. No reports came in on black bass.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Craig D. Campbell Lake Conway Reservoir fishing report
reports.text: Crappie are good. Black bass reports are good. Anglers are using a variety of baits successfully: cranks, plastic worms, topwater plugs, frogs and bass minnows.
